subject: Streaming qualification ops check-in and probe requests
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@retailco.com>; Aaron Mills <aaron.mills@retailco.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Apr 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + concrete asks for streaming perf qualification

Hi Sandeep / Aaron —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and what we need to keep momentum: 

- Goal: validate Redwood serving for RetailCo checkout streaming use case (low-latency token streaming for confirmation flows) at 95th percentile latency targets and steady concurrency.
- RetailCo targets you reiterated on the call: 95th-token latency <= 120ms for 1K active concurrent streams (50 token avg), sustained for 30m windows; tail P99 target <= 260ms.
- Key deliverables from us this week:
  1) a measurement_spec PDF defining exact measurement points and harness commands (attached v2),
  2) a prompt bundle for the streaming probe (attached jsonl),
  3) a reproducible harness command list + env notes (attached txt).

Action items / asks for you:
- Confirm the traffic shape we should emulate (peak vs sustained patterns). If you can drop a sample traffic CSV or a short description we will map it to our harness.
- Confirm whether KV cache priming is allowed for this qualification run or if we should measure strictly cold-start behavior.
- If Procurement needs a formal statement of work before we run any longer soak, loop them in.

I'll get Priyom and Kim to prepare a minimal reproducibility checklist and a quick-run invocation that you can run in your environment (or we can run from Redwood dedicated pool).

Next touchpoint: propose a 30-min walk-through on Wednesday to go over the harness and run the first short probe. Does 10:00–10:30 PT work?

Thanks,

Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: measurement_spec_v2.pdf (measurement definitions), retailco_prompt_bundle_v1.jsonl (prompt samples), raw-harness-commands.txt (invocations)
From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@retailco.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Mills <aaron.mills@retailco.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@retailco.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + concrete asks for streaming perf qualification

Thanks Avery —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few quick answers:

- Traffic shape: primary concern is sustained checkout bursts tied to flash sale windows. Attached is a small CSV with a 30-minute sustained pattern and a 10-minute spike baseline (see sample_traffic_apr02.csv referenced below). For the first probe, please emulate the sustained 1K concurrent streams at 50 token average and add the 10-minute 5K spike as a second run.
- KV cache: we want both measurements — cold-start pass (no priming) and warm-run with a short priming pass to reflect typical session behavior. Please label both clearly.
- Procurement: looping them now — procurement will likely ask for an SOW for the long soak but are fine with the initial probes under the mutual action plan.

We can do Wednesday 10:00 PT for the walkthrough. Priyom / Kimberly — can you send the walk-through invite and a short agenda?

Sandeep
VP Product, RetailCo

References: sample_traffic_apr02.csv (attached separately by RetailCo)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@retailco.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + concrete asks for streaming perf qualification

Thanks Sandeep — adding a short agenda and the walkthrough invite.

Agenda (30 min):
1) Quick overview of measurement_spec_v2 (5 min) — how we define streaming latency (per-token vs end-to-end), sample windows, and client-side latency accounting.
2) Harness walkthrough (10 min) — commands to run locally vs Redwood-run, where to drop the prompt bundle, and how to mark cold vs warm runs.
3) Traffic mapping (5 min) — confirm mapping for sustained 1K and 5K spike run; show CSV ingestion.
4) Results capture & artifacts (5 min) — what JSON artifacts we will deliver (per-run token traces, aggregated percentile tables, raw harness logs).

Invite: Wed Apr 4, 2028 10:00–10:30 PT (Google Meet) — invite sent.

A few clarifying notes in advance so the call can be efficient:
- measurement_spec_v2 defines two latency signals: token_emit_latency (client observe) and models_respond_latency (server-side measured). We'll reconcile them but both will be provided.
- For reproducibility, we will export the harness container image tag and the exact seed for prompt sampling used during the probe.
- Deliverable timeline: short probes results within 48 hours of a successful run; extended soak SOW will be a separate line item.

Kimberly / Monica: please confirm who will own the follow-on SOW and whether we should include a short appendix on data retention and audit logs for compliance.

—Priyom
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: measurement_spec_v2.pdf, raw-harness-commands.txt
From: Aaron Mills <aaron.mills@retailco.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@retailco.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@retailco.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Apr 2028 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + concrete asks for streaming perf qualification

Thanks team — quick confirmation after the walkthrough:

- We ran the short probe from our side using the harness commands. Initial observations: warm-run steady state looks promising; 95th-token latency ~105ms at 1K concurrency. Cold-start run had a couple of spikes near 420ms (we captured logs and attached a short snippet).
- Request: can Redwood provide the harness container tag used and the exact prompt-seed for the run (so our infra team can reproduce locally)? Also please include the command used to enable KV-priming (we want to repeat the warm-run).
- Procurement: we will review SOW language — Aaron will follow up with a PO request if the extended soak looks good.

Forwarded excerpt of probe logs below for context:
> --- probe-run-20280405.log (snippet) ---
> 2028-04-05T16:18:12Z token_emit_latency: 98ms stream_id=...
> 2028-04-05T16:18:13Z token_emit_latency: 112ms stream_id=...
> 2028-04-05T16:22:01Z token_emit_latency: 420ms stream_id=... (cold-start spike)

Avery / Priyom / Kimberly — please respond with the image tag + seed and we will attempt a full local replay tomorrow.

Thanks,
Aaron Mills
Director, Infrastructure — RetailCo
aaron.mills@retailco.com
